Valuation: cash is scored at 1.00 cents per point ($1.00 cash = 100 points-equivalent). Points and cash are ranked on this single yardstick.

Data problems flagged, NOT silently fixed
  - THIS FIXTURE CARRIES NO POINTS PRICES AT ALL. It was built by --new-trip, which refuses to write a points_candidates key - not an empty one, none. The only way any leg here can be scored
on points is --live (real Seats.aero award space) or --from-snapshot (a committed replay of one). A hand-written points price is a badge number wearing a capture's clothes, and quoting those
is the bug this whole project exists to stop. If you add a points_candidates key by hand, this sentence is no longer true of this file and should come out with it.

L2 - LHR->SFO, Jan 29 2027, one-way, business, 2 adults
  Verdict: CASH (NO POINTS PATH) - NO AWARD PRICE WAS CAPTURED FOR THIS LEG and none was fetched, so the points side was never priced. NOTHING is claimed about whether a UR transfer partner 
covers LHR->SFO - that question was never reached. Score it with --live or --from-snapshot, or add a captured award price to the fixture.
  Cash: LHR->SFO Jan 29 2027, entered by the user
  APD: UK AIR PASSENGER DUTY on L2: this leg DEPARTS GB for US. ADDED to the points-side cash total: GBP 244.00 x 2 = GBP 488.00 = $660.75 per the standard rate. Band B chosen because HMRC 
bands by distance from London to the DESTINATION COUNTRY'S CAPITAL: Washington DC, 3665 miles. APD is owed on award tickets too and does not care which program or which airline; the captured
CASH fare already contains it, which is why it is added to the points side only. Source: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/rates-and-allowances-for-air-passenger-duty. The GBP->USD conversion 
above is marked [CONFIRM BEFORE TRUSTING]; this APD figure inherits that uncertainty.

L2 LHR->SFO, Jan 29 2027, one-way, business, 2 adults
  Seats.aero returned 1 award(s) for LHR->SFO on 2027-01-29 (0 on the leg's own date, 1 on other dates).
  coverage: single page: the response carried NO count / hasMore / cursor field, so there was nothing to follow. If Seats.aero is in fact paginating this endpoint by another mechanism, this 
result is page one only - that has NOT been ruled out
  FLEXIBLE-DATE FINDINGS for L2 (searched +/-0 days; these are NOT scored)
    2027-01-27  Virgin Atlantic Flying Club  J  60,000 + GBP 450.00   2 seats   offset(-2)
       Cash for 2027-01-27 has NOT been captured. The cash price on this leg is for 2027-01-29 and is NOT a comparison for this award. To score it, capture the cash fare for 2027-01-27 and 
add it to the fixture with that date on the cash option.
    Why not simply score these against this leg's cash price? Because a flexible search takes the MINIMUM over a window on the points side while cash stays a SINGLE FIXED DRAW, and award 
space is released on low-demand dates that also carry low cash fares. The bias runs in favour of points and grows with the window.
